title: Design System: WALI-EPI Clinical Field Ledger

kpi.purpose: Dashboard summary figures with tabular numerals.

body.purpose: Default UI copy, form controls, and table cells.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, table headers, and status pills.

mono.purpose: NIK, case IDs, coordinates, and SLA timers.

shadows.name: elev-soft
shadows.purpose: Subtle elevation for cards and .surface panels.

motion.name: color-transition
motion.purpose: Interactive hover, focus, and border state transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary clinical action button (submit report, verify PE, save settings).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: var(--control-height, 38px); padding: 0 14px; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 8px); border: 1px solid transparent; background: var(--accent, #0d9488); color: var(--accent-ink, #ffffff); font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 150ms ease, transform 100ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0d9488); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary neutral action button on surface cards and toolbars.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: var(--control-height, 38px); padding: 0 14px; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 8px); border: 1px solid var(--control, #d4d4d8); background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--text, #09090b); font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--raised, #f4f4f5); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0d9488); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form input for NIK, patient identity, and rejection notes.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: var(--control-height, 38px); padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 8px); border: 1px solid var(--control, #d4d4d8); background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--text, #09090b); font-size: 13.5px; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--faint, #71717a); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--accent, #0d9488); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgb(13 148 136 / 0.25); }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Semantic triage status pill with leading dot indicator.
components.css: .ds-pill-warn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 24px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: var(--radius-pill, 999px); border: 1px solid var(--pill-warning-border, #fde68a); background: var(--pill-warning-bg, #fffbeb); color: var(--pill-warning-ink, #92400e); font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-pill-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: currentColor; opacity: 0.8; }

components.name: Surface Card
components.description: Primary architectural container for KPIs, forms, and case panels.
components.html:
Ringkasan Kasus
14 kasus aktif dalam SLA 24 jam.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 16px; border-radius: var(--radius-card, 14px); border: 1px solid var(--border, #e4e4e7); background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--text, #09090b); box-shadow: var(--elev-soft); } .ds-card-title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card-body { font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--muted, #52525b); }

narrative.northStar: Clinical Field Ledger — calm mineral-alabaster precision with deep teal action clarity across mobile field work and desktop triage.
rules: Use CSS custom properties from src/app/globals.css as the single source of truth.
Enforce tabular-nums on all clinical counts, NIKs, dates, and SLA timers.
Keep mobile web workflows fully accessible and ergonomic below 768px.
dos: Use Deep Teal (--accent) strictly for primary actions, active nav, and focus rings.
Read region name, institution name, and logo dynamically from portal settings.
donts: Do not follow legacy design-system/wali-epi/MASTER.md tokens.
Do not use decorative gradients, pie charts, or animate-bounce.
